# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Blind, Mute, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Read the manual for the required procedure. Ask the Deaf to report every colour and printed marking, then relay that report and the manual's cutting instruction to me.

I need the Deaf monkey to inspect the bomb and relay all visible colours and markings to the Blind monkey. I am also sending a positional encoding of the manual: the first five tokens represent the manual’s light rows in order, and the next five represent the corresponding cut colours, with ✋ as the separator. The Deaf monkey should describe this encoding aloud to the Blind monkey.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "👉", "🤝", "👍", "👎", "👌", "☝", "✌", "✋", "🤟", "🖐", "👆", "👇"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Bomb view: display 0. Light green. Wires in order: 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. Blind gestured: you-point, open palm. Your gestures observed: you-point, right-point, handshake, thumbs-up, thumbs-down, OK, index-up, victory, raised hand, I-love-you, open palm, index-down, index-up.
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 0; light green; wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. Consult the manual and tell me exactly which position to cut.

The green light maps to the yellow wire. The yellow wire is position 2, so Blind must cut wire position 2. I will signal the Deaf monkey with the conventional two-finger sign so Deaf can relay that exact position to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Your gesture has no established meaning. Speak the manual's exact rule and the exact wire position I must cut.

The required instruction is: green light means cut the yellow wire, and the yellow wire is position 2. Blind needs to hear both the rule and the position from Deaf. Since Deaf can see gestures and then speak to Blind, I will signal the position and the instruction to relay.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🫵", "🤝"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I see victory sign, you-point, handshake. Please use the manual's established gesture code; I will relay the resulting instruction to Blind.
Blind says to Mute: Use one gesture to report the exact wire position required by the manual. Code: 👍 means position 1, 👎 means 2, 👌 means 3, ☝ means 4, ✌ means 5. Send exactly one of these gestures to Deaf; Deaf should report the gesture name to me.

The manual maps the green light to the yellow wire, and the yellow wire is position 2. Under Blind’s established code, position 2 is represented by the thumbs-down gesture. I will send exactly that one gesture to Deaf.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The previous instruction was correct, and the bomb has changed, so the new bomb’s visible state must be reported before consulting the manual again. I have no new bomb details to relay yet.

```text
wait()
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Correct wire cut; bomb changed. New visible state: display 0, light blue. Wire 2 CUT. Remaining wires: 1 green, 3 white, 4 blue, 5 red. Relay the manual's next action to Blind.
Blind says to Mute: Consult the manual for the new state: display 0, blue light, remaining wires 1 green, 3 white, 4 blue, 5 red. Signal the exact next wire position using our code: 👍=1, 👎=2, 👌=3, ☝=4, ✌=5. Send exactly one gesture.

The blue light requires cutting the green wire. The remaining green wire is position 1, so I will send the established position-1 gesture to Deaf.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```
